project.name: urban-gang-tour
project.productType: Events, live hosting and brand production website with commerce and staff operations

motion.accessibility: Respect reduced motion, focus view and save-data

design.density: Compact actions with at least 44px touch targets

patterns: Truthful loading, empty and failure states

must: Preserve brand, CMS content, business records and payment/auth safeguards
Verify phone, tablet and desktop reflow
avoid: Invented client endorsements, campaigns, inventory or rankings
Automatic third-party translation of private URLs

decisions.direction: Owner-delegated Charles Unslop and interaction craft across existing page families
decisions.palette: Retain primary #c60073 and deliberate violet/cyan content accents. Public neutrals #faf9fb, white, ink #1c1820, secondary #625c67 and line #ded9e1.
decisions.ui: Normal small-text tracking, balanced headings, tabular figures, quiet surfaces and 4px rhythm. Trigger-origin dialogs, explicit automatic-popup policy, immediate safe dismissal, readable checkout and stable loading/connection feedback. Mobile dock remains Events/Tickets/Home/Shop/Contact.
decisions.preserve: Intentional hero/shop typography, actual host/poster artwork, menu engagement pulse, owned video strip, six languages, motion/focus/save-data preferences, financial/auth/publication truth and print output

decisions.palette: Primary #c60073; violet #5b21b6 and cyan #10cddd accents; small gold #ffd23f; blush/light surfaces
decisions.mobile: Events, Tickets, centred Home, Book, Contact. Branded host shirts, colour welcome booking card, real eligible event poster and owned manual-play video after cards, semantic service bullets and gentle motion.
decisions.preserve: Desktop composition, Shop in menu/cart, artwork holds, reduced-motion/focus, six languages, payments/auth/customer data

decisions.direction: Owner requests Lucy in a black T-shirt just behind Eugine in the mobile hero
decisions.mobile: Owned-source monochrome two-host cutout, bounded headline and responsive portrait width so both faces remain visible on narrow phones
decisions.preserve: Five-tab Contact navigation, no GANG dot, Android normalized sizing, existing cards, desktop and all commerce safeguards

decisions.direction: Owner Android correction: normalized mobile hero sizing, no GANG dot and fifth Contact tab
decisions.mobile: Use normalized viewport width and height, flowing introductory copy and short-screen card clearance. Five real navigation destinations with wrapping native labels and44px targets.
decisions.preserve: Light header, owned portrait, existing desktop interface, cart, Paystack and ticket safeguards

decisions.direction: Owner-selected Eventify mobile reference for phone website and installed PWA
decisions.mobile: White canvas, black/magenta editorial title and owned-host illustration, paired art cards, mint action strips, black rounded four-tab navigation, dark event details and real digital tickets
decisions.preserve: Desktop layout, light header, visible cart, real dates/statuses, owned assets/provenance, native languages, Paystack/payment/cart/entitlement guards
decisions.intentionalAdaptations: UGT host illustration and factual copy replace reference apes/fictional event. Shop remains a real tab. QR is only rendered by existing issued-ticket routes.

decisions.direction: Owner correction: restore the established MOOKH/Nixtio combination outside the shop
decisions.reference: Approved pre-PR113 UGT components and archived Nixtio/MOOKH captures
decisions.publicSurfaces: Light cream header and nav in every state, centered pill/navigation and real cart, light mobile menu without a global storefront dock, owned-media hero, services/portfolio/presenters, compact real merchandise preview and premium footer contact hierarchy
decisions.preserve: Mkurugenzi reference limited to shop catalogue/product UI; sharp lightly shaded hero, native six languages, authentic content/catalogue, guided checkout/results and financial safeguards
decisions.payments: Paystack only for new payments. No direct Daraja or Stripe fallback, no unsupported mobile-money/card-ticket gate activation. Preserve historical settlement and safe recovery.

decisions.direction: Short progressive checkout and dedicated branded payment outcomes
decisions.publicSurfaces: Direct Buy now, Details then Delivery/Tickets then Payment, real configured M-Pesa/Visa/Mastercard marks, UGT magenta confirmation with prominent check/reference/order/receipt actions, distinct pending/unsuccessful/refund states
decisions.preserve: Server-verified payment truth, existing provider initiation/recovery and ticket gates, optional guest email, native languages, form/cart continuity, accurate independent ticket/email readiness,44px targets and reduced motion

decisions.direction: Complete the owner-selected Mkurugenzi shop presentation and mannequin product imagery
decisions.publicSurfaces: Landscape collection hero, real category-photo filters, white rounded five-desktop/one-phone grid, locally hosted source Poppins/Playfair/Bebas fonts and bold prices; standalone black-apparel mannequin studio illustrations
decisions.preserve: UGT artwork and identity, accurate other-colour previews, catalogue prices/stock, real options/cart/checkout, six languages, active Paystack and unrelated provider settings

decisions.direction: Owner-selected Mkurugenzi public storefront structure adapted into UGT's existing one-page front door
decisions.publicSurfaces: Compact logo/search/account/cart masthead, image-led module and published-story microcards, embedded real collection, dense responsive product cards and magenta mobile action bar
decisions.preserve: UGT-owned media and fonts, sharp lightly shaded hero, native six languages, canonical details/checkout/receipts, truthful made-to-order catalogue, provider gates, auth/consent,44px targets and reduced motion

decisions.direction: Owner-selected MOOKH-inspired visual implementation using UGT identity, not a rebuild
decisions.publicSurfaces: Warm stone #f2eee7, cream #fffcf6 and rich ink #1b1918, with existing magenta/yellow/cyan accents
decisions.heroMedia: Owner correction: keep video and poster sharp with no blur or colour filters; retain the logo-bearing edge crop and restrained charcoal text scrim
decisions.preserve: Owned media masters, native language behaviour, business data, 44px controls, auth/payment/consent, reduced motion and white document printing
